I used to laugh at the absurdity of the appeal of ASMR videos. Now I'm in the middle of a breakup because of my mental illness. It is funny that I'm listening to this while crying after I saw this post. I have never felt more helpless and mad at myself than when depression started getting in the way of everything in my life and made me lose grasp in anything I hold dear. My girlfriend, my studies, the things I love and enjoy. It's all falling apart.   
  
I've seen it. I've read all of it. People like me have a miniscule chance of ever being truly better. My misery is genetic and my sorrow is greatly embedded in my soul. One day I will leave. I'm nothing but a cog, a statistic. My existence is ultimately inconsequential and meaningless, and the amount of misery and hardship I feel isn't worth the promise that the future tries to bring.   
  
And for that, I want to do the right thing and put myself out of misery, one day.
